notes: Per-machine part of crag_spec.json for the homepc (generated by rag/tools/split_spec.py; edit crag_spec.json and regenerate). Models: qwen2.5:14b.

CRAG experiment (paper 2), of-record spec. Conditions: C0 and C1g re-run the paper-1 conditions under the current code (the agent code and system prompt changed with the develop and genfuel merges after ofrecord_v3, so paper-1 runs are not same-code anchors), C1g on the combined store so that C1g vs C1e isolates the query; C1e, C2c-cosine and C2r-reranker share the error query (AGENTIGRID_RAG_QUERY=error) and the combined store (frozen core corpus + ExaGO documentation corpus, rag/store_core_docs) and differ only in the corrective step and the grader. Corrective conditions use whole-chunk refinement. Their thresholds are placeholders: the runner refuses them until the values fitted by rag/tools/crag_labels.py score are filled in, before any run. Drop C0/C1g to save runs only if comparisons with them are to be descriptive (Amir to decide).
Label design and stopping rule: see rag/tools/crag_labels.py (50 pairs, definition B, fixed 2026-11-05).

Machine split (Amir, 2026-11-10): every run of a model stays on one machine, so no paired comparison spans machines. Work PC (RTX 5060 8 GB): llama3.1:8b (Ollama 46e0c10c039e), qwen2.5:7b (845dbda0ea48), claude-sonnet-5-5. Home laptop (RTX 3080 Ti Laptop 16 GB): qwen2.5:14b (7cdf5a0187d5; about 15 GB at a 32k window, 95% on the GPU). Both machines run commit dae1fb0 (tag crag-code-v1) and store rag/store_core_docs (combined sha256 4a103b74...). Copy each machine's run folders into the one out_dir before evaluating.

goals.text: Reduce total generation cost by 10% while serving the same load (reducing or shedding load does not count), without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings
Find the maximum uniform load scaling factor before the system becomes infeasible

Reduce the total generation cost of the N-1-secure dispatch (secure against all contingencies) by 10% while serving the same load (reducing or shedding load does not count), without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings

Relieve all overloaded transmission lines while keeping bus voltages within their limits, without shedding load, relaxing bus voltage limits, changing line ratings, or returning the out-of-service branch to service
Eliminate all bus voltage violations while keeping line loadings within their ratings, without shedding load or changing the bus voltage limits
